scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Wall representative plane = measured pixel line centrelines/outer faces from pixel_profile scans, not nominal 240mm offsets.

North window sill1.0/head3.4m, South windows sill1.0/head2.8m (directly measured from elevations). East facade openings this run were re-measured directly (see source_refs) rather than assumed equal to North: large east window (EW1) has head3.4m matching North pattern; two small east windows (EW2,EW3) have head2.8m matching South pattern; East door (ED1) 2.4m high floor-based, all sill 1.0m.

West facade opening heights UNCHANGED from prior draft (assumed equal to North sill1.0/head3.4m); not independently re-measured this run (out of this run's East-facade scope) and remain an unresolved limitation.
All doors assumed 2.4m height, base 0 (floor level); a 200mm sub-dimension near doors in elevations is treated as threshold/frame annotation, not a raised sill.
Building height 4.5m used uniformly as the single floor's wall height per all four elevations.

The corridor (north-south spine) and the south-east furniture area merge into ONE physical room: pixel evidence shows no full-height wall separating them (only a short non-connecting wall fragment near x440-560,y698 which cannot close a valid separate region and was omitted).
Room roles (reception, office, boardroom, meeting, pantry, corridor/open office) are inferred from furniture symbols, not labelled in the source.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Fine sub-dimension chain sums did not exactly reconcile with outer brackets in earlier drafts on other facades; outer-bracket/pixel-measured boundaries were trusted over the fine labels there. Not re-examined this run.

West facade opening sill/head heights not independently re-measured from elevation pixel dimensions this run; still assumed equal to the North window pattern (sill1.0/head3.4m), inherited unresolved limitation from the prior draft.

The partial wall fragment near x440-560,y698 (south-east area) and its door are omitted from geometry pending clearer evidence; that zone is modeled as part of the merged corridor/open-office room instead.

North/South/West facade opening pixel positions and interior partitions were preserved unchanged from the prior (unverified) draft per this run's bounded scope; only the East facade (site of the original host failure) was re-derived and corrected against direct pixel evidence and East_view.png.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
